landing.badge: All-in-one digital companion for Indian farmers
landing.heroTitle: Farming, Schemes & Mandi Prices — All in One Place.
landing.heroDesc: Government subsidies, crop insurance, live mandi rates, farmer marketplace and your farm ledger. 100% free and simple in Hindi and English.
landing.servicesSubtitle: Every essential farming tool and information in a single app
landing.featSchemes: Eligibility and application guides for PM-KISAN, KCC, Soil Health Card and other govt schemes.
landing.featMarket: Daily wholesale and modal arrival prices across Indian mandis directly from data.gov.in (Agmarknet).
landing.featInsurance: PMFBY premium rates, coverage stages, cutoff dates and 72-hour crop loss claim steps.
landing.featMarketplace: Buy and sell crops, certified seeds, fertilisers and farm equipment directly with fellow farmers.
landing.featFinance: A simple ledger to record cultivation expenses, fertiliser costs, harvest sales and net profit.
landing.featDocuments: Extract printed and handwritten text from land records (Khasra-Khatauni) and bills in Hindi & English.
landing.featKnowledge: Scientifically verified agronomic practices for wheat, paddy, soil health, drip irrigation and pest control.
landing.trustDesc: All schemes and mandi prices are directly connected to official Government of India sources (Agmarknet, data.gov.in, PM-KISAN, PMFBY).
landing.farmerQuote: "With Kheti, I can compare mandi prices directly and get PMFBY claim assistance without running to middlemen."
